newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nippon Oil Feb refining rises, product imports fall.
newsitem.headline: Nippon Oil Feb refining rises, product imports fall.

text.p: Nippon Oil Co Ltd said on Thursday it raised crude processing while reducing product imports in February in order to cut costs.

"Nippon Oil produced more oil products at its refineries and reduced imports of oil products in February because of the high price of imported products," managing director Fumiaki Watari told reporters.
In February, Nippon Oil's imports of oil products fell to 2.7 percent from 6.5 percent in January, Watari said.
He said imports of regional crudes rose to 13 percent of total imports in February from six percent in January.
Imports of light Middle Eastern crudes also increased, he said without giving concrete figures.

Regional crudes, which are generally low in sulphur, are suited to produce environmentally friendly products, while light crudes tend to yield a greater amount of middle distillates such as kerosene and gasoline.
